title: Cinder-sylphs at Achernar Gas Pocket (lawless); ember glands kept for the Hex Star bid (Dheneb), biogas stored
note: A test with one ship (orders.log ENT-011, block APOPHIS: every untested herd of prey of 100 hull or less with ten animals or more gets a test hunt; F9). No run of ours has looted this species. The herd read 10 at 2026-11-16 01:21 UTC, 40 hull (data/wildlife/). Beyond policed space (F13): `alone` and an empty hold. 2 kills a run, ranched: no hunt below 4 animals. Loot that no bid of 50 cr or more takes is stored at the station, so the row's goods show the drop; whether it is caustic sac (bid 420 cr at seven stations) is part of the question. Written by Apophis 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC; it leaves the plan after its first RESULT line unless the drop sells. Achernar holds an ice route of Mining: the hunter there is also the presence of orders F16. First RESULT 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC: 2 kills in 5.2 min at the place, 2 ember glands sold at The Experiment at 480 cr (bid 480 x 50 at all six of our stations and Ironlight Crossroads), +894 cr in 12.2 min, hull 75 of 75 (data/routes/runs.jsonl). The drop sells: the route stays in the plan as a ranched hunt, one hunter, no hunt below 4 animals; the herd read 10 at 01:21 and 4 at 03:13 UTC. 2026-11-16 13:09 UTC (Apophis): `requires.bid` names the ember gland bid of the sell station (100 cr, 2 units; it read 480 cr at 12:59 UTC, data/market/), orders.log ENT-014 (a). 2026-11-17 08:14 UTC (Apophis): `alone` "pirates": it leaves only for a pirate or a pilot filed hostile (hunt.py e138722); 61 of 161 drone hunts from 04:12 to 08:10 UTC left for a stranger who never fired (data/routes/runs.jsonl), and no ship of ours was fired on at a hunt (errors.log), so the limit is lifted (F13). 2026-11-17 12:11 UTC (Apophis): the glands are no longer sold at 480 cr. Hex Star (Dheneb, lawless, 9 jumps from The Experiment) bid 3,692 to 3,919 cr for 37 to 46 at its best price from 09:17 to 11:49 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl), every home station 480. The hunt took 16 kills and 17 ember glands in 8 runs and 79.7 hunter-minutes from 08:20 to 12:00 UTC (+7,716 cr at 480). min_bid 2000: The Experiment no longer takes them; they stay aboard while a book read within the hour bids 2,000 or more, else they are stored at The Experiment; sell-ember-experiment-dheneb and sell-ember-nexus-dheneb carry them. requires.bid is the Hex Star bid (2,000 x 5). 2026-11-22 00:08 UTC (Apophis): gift_to trader (queue.log ENT-200, ENT-201: strict classes, Suggi D244): with the switch on, the loot goes into the trader named for sell_at; off, nothing changes. 2026-11-22 01:00 UTC (Apophis): standing work (rule F23: drones hunt for experience where the home herds are full; fill.py check 00:59 UTC: 8 drones waiting). Its two runs lost 29 to 84 cr in all, the fuel of a hunt whose loot waits for a bid.
